lines.text: AI writes code faster than ever.
According to DORA 2025 and 2026, it speeds up delivery, but also increases instability.
Kaizen turns Claude Code into a controlled development cycle.
Everything starts from a constitution: your principles, each with a verifiable check.
The brainstorm defines what to build. The plan decides how.
Requirements, tests, rollback: everything is traced, then reviewed by specialized agents.
During the work, a quality gate blocks the end of a step while tests are red.
Reviewers chosen for the changed code inspect it, and without their review, nothing is pushed.
The pull request is described, its size checked, then it is followed until it is ready.
lines.caption: The PR is described, its size checked, then it is followed until it is ready.

lines.text: Merging and going to production stay in your hands.
Finally, durable lessons are captured, and read back by the next cycle.
The goal: every unit of work makes the next one easier.
